detail: TC-01/02/04 seed oscar with only 99999 while TC-03 seeds oscar with 99999 plus product 99 x2, all in the same basket-edge scenario. Use distinct users or a per-case seeding step so each case has a well-defined precondition.
TC-04 uses alice as the empty-basket control, but TC-05 adds a two-line basket for alice to the same scenario, so the control is no longer empty. Use a different user for TC-05.
'WebApp logs contain no KeyNotFoundException' is not observable through a Playwright e2e test (HTTP/UI/DB). Replace with observable assertions: the page renders and no Blazor error UI is shown.
'no item count badge (or 0)' permits two outcomes; pick one concrete expected rendering.
Same basket as TC-01 and TC-04, and TC-03 already asserts the badge count; merge into TC-01/TC-03.
'No checkout/update controls for a line item' is not in the story; limit to the empty-cart message.

The case asserts no '99999' text in the header and no count change. The story allows the cart to 'drop (or flag)' the line, so a valid flag could fail this check. Assert only that the site renders without error and that the missing line contributes nothing to the count.
The index says each case uses its own user, but oscar is used in both TC-BUG-7-01 and TC-BUG-7-04. The case numbering also skips TC-BUG-7-02. Make the statement consistent with the cases.
